movelist.name: Sunny Day
movelist.effect: The weather becomes Sunny for 5 rounds. While Sunny, Fire-Type Attacks gain a +5 bonus to Damage Rolls, and Water-Type Attacks suffer a -5 Damage penalty.

movelist.name: Lava Plume
movelist.effect: Lava Plume burns all targets on 16+.

movelist.name: Fire Punch
movelist.effect: Fire Punch Burns the target on 19+ during Accuracy Check.

movelist.name: Flame Burst
movelist.effect: Any Trainers or Pokémon cardinally adjacent to the target lose 5 Hit Points.

movelist.name: Clear Smog
movelist.effect: The target’s Combat Stages are reset to their default, and all Coats on the target are destroyed. Clear Smog cannot miss.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the Enraged and Infatuated conditions. Defensive.

abilities.name: Vital Spirit
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the Sleep condition, and cannot use the move Rest. Defensive.

abilities.name: Type Aura
abilities.effect: The user and all allies within 3 meters gain a +5 Bonus to Damage Rolls with Moves matching the user’s Primary Type.
